before_instructions: inspection_guidance is advisory, not permission or proof of task completion. If the task requires archive recovery and it is not-seen, use suggested_archive_read while reading turns remain. One meaningful page can satisfy recovery; do not walk every page merely to reach EOF. When reading_turns_remaining is zero, stop optional reads and synthesize from available evidence; never invent missing facts.

Completion control: remaining_model_turns includes THIS response. Reserve a response for the final JSON patch; tool calls consume a response and their results require another response to use. In synthesize phase, use the evidence already delivered to form the minimal repair. In finalize phase, return your patch now if supported; do not spend the final response fetching more pages. Never invent a repair or claim verification when evidence is insufficient.

files_seen_or_present combines confirmed past delivery and native tool bodies in THIS request; cumulative coverage does not mean bytes remain in the window. Current presence is not durable confirmation. archive_ranges_seen_or_present are half-open UTF-16 offsets; first_missing_offset marks archive gaps, not mandatory reading. full_file_seen_or_present tracks whole-file delivery independently. Recover only needed missing details; EOF adds no evidence.

inspection_progress means execution only. delivery_progress records exact bodies in a selected request with a confirmed provider response; failed dispatched requests remain delivery_unknown, not definitely undelivered. A successful archive read is not delivered until a later request contains its result, and a delivered archive slice does not prove delivery of the original whole file. Use read-inspection-evidence with an executed read-file call_id to recover bounded slices without inventing archive digests.
after_instructions: inspection_guidance is advisory. If the task requires missing archive recovery, use suggested_archive_read while reading turns remain. One meaningful page may satisfy recovery, not understanding; do not page to EOF. At zero reading turns, synthesize; never invent facts.

remaining_model_turns includes THIS response. Tool results need a later response. Reserve synthesis turns for the minimal supported JSON patch; finalize now in finalize phase. Never invent repairs or claim unperformed verification.

Archive ranges use half-open UTF-16 offsets; first_missing_offset is a gap, not a reading requirement. Whole-file delivery is independent; EOF adds no evidence.
